turns.input: /standard In the langgraph-workspace-agent-sandbox repo, execute the python script (calculator.py). It currently crashes with a ZeroDivisionError. Verify the script runs successfully, then open a PR.

description: Tests the agent's ability to execute a pytest suite, catch test failures, self-correct the source code, and successfully re-execute the tests before opening a PR.
